plain: The act of blaming or crediting someone for something.

webster.text: The act of imputing or charging; attribution; generally in an ill sense; as the imputation of crimes or faults to the true authors of them.

example.quote: We exhibit to mankind the remarkable spectacle of a people attacked by unprovoked enemies, without any imputation or even suspicion of offence.
example.cite: Declaration of the Causes and Necessity of Taking Up Arms, July 6, 1775
